responsibility: Implements the core Darwin target backend support shared across front ends and architectures. It owns Mach-O section initialization and selection, symbol-indirection and PIC-related Darwin helpers, constructor/destructor bookkeeping, Darwin-specific declaration and assembly output, CFString constant construction and tracking, builtin patching support, unwind/exception emission details, and policy for placing functions into hot/cold/startup/exit or coalesced Mach-O sections. This is the main executable implementation file behind darwin.h and darwin-protos.h, focused on backend code generation and object-file layout rather than driver or frontend parsing.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable implementation file in the Darwin same-name group: it contains the backend code and helper functions for Mach-O section selection, CFString emission, symbol indirection, and other Darwin target behavior, whereas darwin.h defines the target macros/spec hooks and darwin.opt only declares the Darwin option table.
